metadata_only_inputs.text: Use the existing C5C serialized operand schema, not new names: subjects (list canonical required categories), exclude_subjects (list canonical forbidden categories), exclude_terms (list broad whole-word text exclusions), author_text, title_text, exact_text (strings), rating_min/rating_max/year_min/year_max (numbers), corresponding *_exclusive (bool comparator flags), formats (list ONLINE/PHYSICAL/BOTH required access), exclusive_formats (list explicit ONLY modifier), excluded_formats (explicit forbidden formats), availability (AVAILABLE_NOW or REQUESTABLE), language. expected_sort is separate RELEVANCE/RATING/NEWEST/TITLE. These are schema names only, not author labels or candidate outputs. Author/title operand strings are literal field values; they do not establish unique external bibliography identity. Keep optional preferences separate; no hard author_exact/title_exact keys. Do not infer excluded_formats merely from a required ONLINE access modifier. Record this schema clarification as an additional metadata-only input in provenance. No change to read restrictions or blind semantic judgment.
